description: This header file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for reading file properties, file contents, checking file types, searching files recursively, and expanding variables in strings. It includes functions like readPropertyFromFile, readFileContent, isRegularFile, searchFilesRec, and ExpandPropertiesInString, and references external libraries such as fstream, iostream, regex, and system calls.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, with support for recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching patterns in directories, with exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive file search with specified depth and exclusions.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Replaces variables in a string with their corresponding property values from a file.
